description: Bitcoin Coin Days Destroyed (CDD) metric for recent days or a specific date, measuring economic weight of transferred coins weighted by their dormancy period. Includes documented calculation methodology. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_btc_chain_tips when you need recent stale/orphaned Bitcoin blocks and sidechain forks; crypto_btc_block when you need Detailed Bitcoin block summary by height or hash. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: Optional specific date in YYYY-MM-DD format

days.description: Number of recent daily records to return

name: crypto_btc_coin_days_destroyed
title: Bitcoin Coin Days Destroyed metric for recent days
